regions.full_page: Andrew Wheeler of 686 Manistique, Det. - 36 - Methodist - Operation on brain tuomer Febr. 23 - improved for time then infection set in ... operated again March 12 - Enrolled March 23rd when things were quite threatening ..... Came home next day - day before yesterday, is here To-day thankful that he feels again "Normal" except a little weak. Drs. in Ann arbor - Peet & Wood - call it miraculous that a patient should talk intelligently four days after such an operation ..... Deo Gratias Oct. 18, 1944 Thank God .... Both Mr. & Mrs. here To-day. He has recently started reading .. "City of God" and is de- cidedly hopeful of entire recovery - is enthused at same.

regions.full_page: Case of Andy Wheeler March 23 - 26 1943 - Introduced by (Elder) Catholic (Mrs. ? ) when he was still unconscious in hospital, his wife weeping promised: "I'll do anything to please the Lord , if He only spares my poor, dear Husband." Never heard from them after a week or so till October 16th 1944 and two days later when he was in perfect health.
